objective: Fix the Pulse signal edit, let admins and mods file unlimited bug reports, keep the ghost plus pulse animation running, and add incoming/views delete.
userOutcome: Editing the signal from the Pulse sheet saves; staff can file bug reports without a cap; a pulsing ghost keeps both animations; incoming cruushes and views can be cleared without touching the sender.
audience: cruush members and the 1.6 release-email audience.
successCriteria: Staff bypass the support-create cap; members keep it.
Pulsing ghost markers keep their rotation animation.
mustPreserve: Preserve approved custom map tiles, theme, people pins, Ghost Mode, Dark Room, Pulse, and unrelated map behavior.
Preserve existing published spots, check-ins, Pink Book posts, ratings, and unrelated 1.6 work.
Never display gay spot, dyke spot, or dyke bar as a public label.
Do not infer trans or nonbinary presence from profiles or scraped visitor data.
Harassment-only Stream results must publish with flagged moderator review, while mixed unsafe labels and non-harassment flags retain their existing enforcement.
Keep user-facing copy free of em dashes and spell cruush lowercase.
nonGoals: No change to Pulse allowances or radius rules.
No change to what a member may report.
Dismissing an incoming cruush never edits the sender history.

assumptions.statement: The prior user-controlled Sniffies extraction may be reused if its full source cache can be recovered locally.
assumptions.impact: The complete public source set can be imported without a new competitor scrape.

assumptions.statement: Source-platform places can initially use Leans men, and independently sourced women-centered venues can use Leans women, while future crowd composition comes from cruush aggregate data.
assumptions.impact: Search has useful initial lean labels without gay or dyke labels or trans/nonbinary inference.

assumptions.statement: Public venue descriptions, non-sensitive access directions, and aggregate popular-time history are acceptable imports; private access details are not.
assumptions.impact: Spot details can be useful without exposing sensitive information.

nextVisibleMilestone: Signal edits save from the Pulse sheet on cruush.app.
stopConditions: Stop the data-expansion slice if the full prior source cache cannot be recovered or if a source record is private or unsafe to publish.
Stop publication because push and deployment are not authorized by this task.
